POTENTIA-AUTUMNS_TOUCH.description: At the start of your turn, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into {Cards:plural:a random card|random cards} of [blue]1[/blue] higher rarity. [gold]Rare[/gold] cards become random upgraded [gold]Rare[/gold] cards. Cards that are not [gold]Common[/gold], [gold]Uncommon[/gold], or [gold]Rare[/gold] become a random [gold]Common[/gold] Potentia card.
POTENTIA-AUTUMNS_TOUCH.title: Autumn's Touch
POTENTIA-CHARGED_CORE.description: The first cost [blue]X[/blue] card you spend energy on each turn has [blue]{Recharge}[/blue] additional [gold]Recharge[/gold].
POTENTIA-CHARGED_CORE.title: Charged Core
POTENTIA-GNARLED_BRUSH.title: Gnarled Brush
POTENTIA-IMBUED_CORE.description: The first cost [blue]X[/blue] card you spend energy on each turn has [blue]{Recharge}[/blue] additional [gold]Recharge[/gold].
POTENTIA-IMBUED_CORE.title: Imbued Core
POTENTIA-INK_BOTTLE.description: Whenever you spend exactly {Energy:energyIcons()} on a cost [blue]X[/blue] card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies and gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
POTENTIA-INK_BOTTLE.title: Ink Bottle
POTENTIA-LASER_PISTOL.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Energy Volley|Energy Volleys}[/gold] to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
POTENTIA-LASER_PISTOL.title: Laser Pistol
POTENTIA-PISTON.description: At the start of each combat, add [gold]Retain[/gold] to a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
POTENTIA-PISTON.selectionScreenPrompt: Select a card to add [gold]Retain[/gold] to.
POTENTIA-PISTON.title: Piston
POTENTIA-UNSTABLE_CABLE.description: Whenever you apply a new debuff to an enemy, apply [blue]{ShockPower}[/blue] [gold]Shock[/gold].
POTENTIA-UNSTABLE_CABLE.title: Unstable Cable
